purpose: Pre-registration for the held-out evaluation: detector parameters and calibration boxes are frozen BEFORE the human ground-truth commits for match A and match B, and before any detector run on either match.

leadInMs.rule: tuned on match A only from {20000, 30000, 45000, 60000} ms as the smallest value where every labelled goal jump lands before playMs; frozen before match B is run

match-a.how: same broadcaster graphic (Belmont Media Center 2023 design) as the development match: the box saved for that broadcaster is reused unchanged — the once-per-broadcaster calibration the product promises

match-b.how: 2024 design (different overlay): box drawn on the 2:00 frame only, around both score boxes and team names, excluding the period box

disclosure: To place the boxes, the detector's author (agent) looked at one frame of each match at 2:00. Match A's graphic at that frame reads 'BELMONT 0 WOBURN 1, 1st, 40:00' (game clock not yet running); match B's reads 0-0. No other frame of A or B was viewed and no detector, bench or visibility run has been made on A or B.
matchTolerance: a marker matches a labelled change when |changeMs - graphicMs| <= BIF interval (10 s) + label precision
headlineRule: claimed only as k/N goal jumps landing before the play on match B, with a Clopper-Pearson 95% interval; never as a bare rate
pass2Reach: ceil(15 min / BIF interval) frames (90 at 10 s) — scan.ts REACH_MS
revisions: 2026-10-13 ~01:00 WIB: reach split (pass 1 = 12 frames, pass 2 = 15 min) after QA round 2 for responsiveness; no A/B data had been seen or run.
